event_source_audit.finding: fast uses displacement only; activation belongs to else (flinch/cough). External-drive conversion inactive in nominal regime. Only u/events/event_info/motion_components depend on this fast event time; all other fields checked unchanged.

conventions.seeds: Running numbers zero-based per fresh block; settings outermost.
conventions.perturbation: Only stiffness multiplied after imported arm; sigma/chi unchanged; k_ret actual controller return.
conventions.identification: Round2 own-arm masks/validity; finite returns pooled, missing counted. Fast iff sc[v]*1000>15 mm/s.
conventions.crossing_force: Round2 fast mask rise|fall|reversal, pooled within fast scenes; RMS fax-FD.
conventions.beta: Gain used before update; median all t>3 ticks; pre-event last tick t<6.
conventions.event_window: [6,event end+.6]; error round2 validity; force RMS all control ticks.
conventions.direction: Huber mean fax [6,6.12) minus [5.9,6); positive=toward; paired delag same label.
conventions.R4: Weakness: positive paired mean event RMS delta; bound: full-episode mean L delta and max peak both arms.
conventions.smoothness: Raw second difference at 1ms; original closed event interval vs elsewhere excluding 2ms margins. Sign from stored-u curvature correlation.

prespecified_predictions.S1: Block 2: every abs(delag2 L - huber L) <= .01, including V4.
prespecified_predictions.S2: Original A_large mean within .01 of delag; block 1 mean within .02 of delag; every A_large/block1 delag2-huber delta <= .02.
prespecified_predictions.S3: Original cases 0-23: every abs(delag2 L - huber L) <= .005.
prespecified_predictions.S4: Block 5: mean delag2-huber L delta <= .02; away-from-probe separately.

V4.spectrum_convention: fax-FD after first >0.2 N divergence, demeaned Hann periodogram, largest non-DC bin

conventions.correction: delag2: k_c=clip(k_w/r,200,3e5), r=clip(1+beta*x/Cw,.5,2); zero beta returns original k_w exactly; gain update unchanged.
conventions.scoring: Unchanged round2 masks and round3 pooling/event/direction conventions.
conventions.original_rows: Block 0 in robust JSON; primary traces in trajectory_loop; huber/delag original reference rows in trajectory_loop.json.
conventions.provenance: All pre-round4 rows retained unchanged; stored huber/delag reused; V4 exact matched reruns saved separately in summary.
